## Upload Data From CoralNet

```{r}
CoralNet <- read_csv(here("Data/SfM/CoralNetAnalysis.csv"))
CoralNetReference <- read_csv(here("Data/SfM/CoralNetGrowthForms.csv"))
```

mutate( full_name = case_match(abbrev, c("NY", "NYC") \~ "New York", "LA" \~ "Los Angeles", c("SF", "SFO") \~ "San Francisco", .default = NA_character\_

```{r}
SubstrateCoverData <- 
  left_join(CoralNet, CoralNetReference, by = c("CoralNetAbb"))
view(SubstrateCoverData)
```

\

```{r}
SubstrateCoverDataWide <- SubstrateCoverData %>%
  mutate(Count = 1) %>%
  select(SiteName, Quadrant,Name, Count) %>%

pivot_wider(names_from = Name, values_from = Count,
            values_fill = 0)
```
